title: Reduce complete rational parameter solve/check time by 15.49% (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Reduce complete rational parameter solve-and-check wall time by **15.49%** on a declared six-parameter workload, preserving every certificate byte. Median time is 0.079004 → 0.066770 seconds across seven alternating runs per arm, with disjoint ranges and zero errors.

```diff
 complete rational-box CLI, unchanged basis order and primal-dual checker
-  Fraction Gauss-Jordan square solves
+  row-wise denominator clearing
+  fraction-free integer elimination and exact back substitution
```

Claim type: scoped implementation proof, finite correctness evidence and a local performance measurement. This is a new opt-in implementation of the complete parameter caller, not an audit of its predecessor. No new kappa or LP theorem is claimed. Only `research/rational-box-fraction-free/` is added.

The contribution was produced by Nick Petalas. Credit Ali Romman / [PR5792](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5792) for the original bounded optimizer, exact dual checker, regression tests and guide; zxv for the inherited parser helpers; and classical fraction-free elimination, Sylvester identities and LP duality. All predecessor bytes and credits remain unchanged.

## Evidence

- Before: a separate complete-optimizer profile places 0.099 of 0.123 profiled seconds in 814 square solves. Profiled times are excluded from the benchmark.
- After: seven alternating complete CLI solve/check pairs per arm, each including two fresh interpreters, actual optimization, certificate serialization and a separate certificate check. Every output reports objective 24 and 757 examined bases and is byte-identical. Baseline wall range 0.077945..0.080634 seconds; candidate 0.066205..0.069032. Median child CPU time is 0.075766 → 0.063610 seconds. No cached optimum is used.
- Local warning-strict normal and optimized checks pass: 5,985 exact systems, including 1,161 independently classified singular cases in the exhaustive two-dimensional domain; eight kernel controls; six inherited regression groups; complete exported CLI byte equality; all three actual source corruptions reject before engine import. The written argument covers the bounded interface; the census corroborates it.
- Registered package replay passes in both modes. Direct registered checks were timed locally at about 0.46 and 0.50 seconds, below their 120-second limits; the final combined registered run took 1.30 seconds.
- Committed bytes and source ancestry pass for all 12 package/input files at `d2d0d6cd0d1445e534e68983d1b06e201432e556`. Official export integrity passes. Both complete read-only, Git-free exported replays pass and produce identical receipts. In-memory compilation and whitespace checks pass.

Exact reproduction from the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B -W error research/rational-box-fraction-free/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -O -B -W error research/rational-box-fraction-free/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/rational-box-fraction-free
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/rational-box-fraction-free --check-source-history
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B -W error research/rational-box-fraction-free/benchmark.py
```

Any CPython 3.12 interpreter may replace that local path. Standard library only. The verifier and benchmark print generated source-hash-bound receipts. `IMB_RUN_DIR` can select an existing external scratch directory. The benchmark records every raw sample and checks source stability before and after measurement. It is deliberately outside the CI gate.

Measurement environment: macOS 27.0.1 arm64, CPython 3.12.15, 18 logical CPUs, unreserved host with another Python process active. The README contains every raw wall-time sample, the exact workload, proof, limits and overlap coverage. This is one bounded parameter-tool workload, not a supplier invoice or a uniform performance guarantee. The predicted implementation scope in the [advance CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19294680) is delivered, and work stopped at the first passing improvement.

## Limitations

The original limits remain six parameters, 24 total rows, at most 50,000 active bases, a checked feasible incumbent and rational input magnitudes through 10^9. The runner is opt-in and authenticates exact source bytes. The optional benchmark uses POSIX `resource`; Windows performance is unclaimed. External Python linters were unavailable.

No source-to-constraint proof, native supplier, physical ownership/restoration, precision/tape implementation, compiler admission, selected scientific replay, Lean or Docker run is supplied. The selected frontier and all five framework assumptions remain unchanged. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Open next questions

1. Can the unchanged complete feasibility checks be accelerated without changing the first optimal basis or output bytes? Begin with a separate profile after this kernel and retain a new complete-path comparison.
2. Which authenticated supplier parameter problem benefits from this complete solver? Derive every row from one pinned full bill and certify a positive margin; an LP optimum alone does not establish physical legality.

## Related open work

- [PR6272](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6272) uses denominator clearing for complete rational-rank certificate product checks. It changes a different source script and caller; this PR changes square elimination in the bounded rational-box optimizer. No timing or certificate-count comparison is asserted.

The completion refresh inspected all thirteen open account PRs created since the advance CLAIM, including this PR. None of the twelve other contributions targets this rational-box optimizer or its complete solve/check workload. No same-instance numerical disagreement was identified, and no extra computations checked other submissions. PR5792 is merged and remains the credited source. Search coverage is bounded and does not prove global novelty.

## CI notes

Both hosted checks, `plan` and `replay (research/rational-box-fraction-free)`, passed at exact head `d2d0d6cd0d1445e534e68983d1b06e201432e556` in [run 41066931363](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41066931363). The completed checks were read once; separate run metadata confirms completed status, success and the matching head. All declared local checks and publication/export controls above also pass. Hosted replay certifies the registered finite checks and source bindings. The local timing measurement remains outside the CI gate; independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way. The isolated opt-in package can be removed without changing default commands or predecessor sources.

**Blast Radius:** isolated. This adds no shared-code, selected-frontier or dependency changes.
